rules.message: This request was already decided ({status}).
An account or pending request already exists for '{email}'.
This link is invalid or has expired.
No account with that email.
This record was already removed.
A saved record is corrected with a reason or removed with a reason; it cannot go back to a draft.
This record was removed and cannot be corrected.
Choose an existing emission source or describe a new one, not both.
Say how chapter 5 treats this adoption: VINTAGE_PROGRESSION, RETROSPECTIVE_ADOPTION, or ERRATUM_ON_REPORTED_YEAR.
The comparison run must be a run of the base-year inventory '{inventory}'.
A decision is either RECALCULATED or DECLINED.

The {year} base year has a recalculation candidate above the significance threshold ({reason}). An inventory that reports against the base year cannot be {act} until the recalculation is completed or declined. Calculation runs stay available, because quantifying the movement is how a recalculation is assessed.
The base-year inventory has no final run to compare with. Designate one first.
The recalculated base must be a run of the base-year inventory '{inventory}'.
A recalculated base year is a run of the base-year inventory. Name the run.
Run {run} is voided and cannot be the recalculated base.
Give the affected share of base-year emissions, or name a comparison run of the base-year inventory.
Structural changes are detected when an inventory is frozen. Freeze the inventory instead.
The organizational boundary is empty. Add at least one facility before freezing it.
The membership window ends before it starts.
A proxy factor needs a justification: say what the factor stands in for.
This inventory has already been superseded.
Only a published inventory can be superseded.
A correction needs a reason of at least 10 characters: what was wrong in the published inventory.
'{category}' is not declared as covered; only a declared category can be marked as not quantified.
{category} is not a scope 3 category.
Say why '{category}' is not quantified (at least 10 characters).
A density for '{material}' already exists.
The disposal date is before the acquisition date.
'{entity}' still has facilities. Move them to another entity before deleting it.
An entity named '{name}' already exists.
'{parent}' is held through '{entity}': a parent chain cannot loop.
{field} must be between 0 and 100.
A link starts with https:// or http://.
Attach a PDF, an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP), a spreadsheet (XLSX, XLS, CSV) or a text file.
A record exclusion needs a justification of at least 10 characters.
'{facility}' has recorded activity data. Facts are the audit trail: remove or reassign its activity records before deleting the facility.
The lease ends before it starts.
'{factor}' was applied by a calculation run. Set its validity end to retire it instead of deleting it.
The mass fractions of a blend must add up to 1 (for example HFC-32:0.5,HFC-125:0.5).
'{factor}' is applied by a classification in {where}. Choose another factor there before deleting it.
'{factor}' came from the factor pack '{pack}'. A pack-derived factor is never deleted, because its versions are the record of what was calculated with. Set its validity end to retire it instead.
You entered '{name}'. A factor is checked by someone other than the person who typed it (Corporate Standard chapter 7): ask {checker} to approve it.
The inventory is already a draft.
The inventory is already frozen.
{records} the freeze: {listed}. Classify or exclude them first.
No run is designated final.
Designate a final run before publishing the inventory.
Reopening needs a reason of at least 10 characters: what the draft will change. The next freeze cuts a new boundary version.
{email} is already a member of '{organization}'.
'{organization}' needs at least one owner.
This notice is already {status}. A decision on an edition is made once.
'{organization}' cannot be deleted while its records stand: {records}. Publish records are kept: withdraw the final designation or supersede the published inventory first.
Type the organization's name exactly to confirm.
An organization named '{name}' already exists: {duplicates}. Confirm to use the name anyway.
'{edition}' is already {status}. An edition is published once; clone it into a new draft to correct a row.
'{edition}' is already withdrawn.
Give the date the edition applies from. It is the vintage boundary an adoption is run from.
'{edition}' applies from {appliesFrom}, which falls inside '{inventory}' ({start} to {end}), which is {status}. A reported period keeps the factors it reported with. {exit}
The approver must not be the curator. {curator} built this draft, so somebody else checks it against the source document and publishes it.
'{edition}' is a draft, which no organization can see. Delete it instead of withdrawing it.
'{edition}' was imported by {holders}, so its rows are part of their records and it is kept.
An edition named '{edition}' already exists. An edition identifier is the citation a report prints, so it is never reused.
'{edition}' is {status}. A published edition's rows, metadata and values never change, because reports already rest on them. Clone it into a new draft instead.
Upload the source document first. A published edition is a citation, so the document it was transcribed from is kept with its SHA-256.
Say why the edition is withdrawn, in at least {min} characters. It is the record a verifier reads beside the figures that rest on it.
{what} needs a reason of at least 5 characters.
A residual mix that is available needs its factor in kg CO2e per kWh.
This action needs the {needed} role in the organization.
Run {run} is already voided.
Run {run} cannot be designated final. {holds}
Run {run} is designated final. Withdraw the designation, with a reason, before voiding it.
A published inventory's runs are a record and cannot be voided.
Run {run} is voided and cannot be designated final.
'{name}' has activity records. Move them to another emission source before deleting it.
'{facility}' already has an emission source named '{name}'.
'{facility}' has an emission source with a similar name: {candidates}. Use it, or give a reason to create '{name}' as a separate source.
The emission source '{name}' belongs to '{owner}', not to '{facility}'.
Say in at least 10 characters why this is a different source.
You already hold support access to '{organization}' until {until}. End it before assuming it again.
Support access cannot {act}. That is the organization's own decision, so a reviewer or an owner of the organization has to make it.
You are a member of '{organization}'; membership already gives you access, so support access does not apply.
Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
A custom unit named '{code}' already exists.
'{code}' is already a registered unit.
'{upstream}' is per {upstreamUnit}, which does not convert from '{primary}' per {primaryUnit}. Choose an upstream factor in a unit the primary factor converts to.
This reset link has expired. Reset links are valid for 1 hour.
This reset link is not valid.
This reset link has already been used.
Nothing changed, so there is nothing to record.
Give a reason of at least {min} characters.
Support access lasts between {min} and {max} hours.
Invalid email or password.
A user with email '{email}' already exists.
At least one active administrator must remain.
The current password is not correct.
Choose a password different from your current one.
At least 12 characters, with a letter and a digit.
Enable the account before sending a password reset link.
This account has not set its first password yet; the link in its approval email still works.
You cannot delete your own account.
You cannot demote or disable your own account.
